# {Applies rank-proportional deterministic soft selection over the top-k utility bottleneck edges to assign graded, anti-cyclic penalties without relying on stochasticity or rigid thresholds.}

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    
    n_edges = len(local_opt_tour)
    avg_edge = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    base_penalty = 0.3 * avg_edge
    
    # Deterministic rank-based selection over top-k bottleneck edges
    k = max(1, min(n_edges, int(np.ceil(np.sqrt(n_edges)))))
    sorted_order = np.argsort(utilities)[::-1]
    top_indices = sorted_order[:k]
    
    # Linear rank-decay weights to penalize worst bottlenecks while avoiding cyclic re-penalization
    rank_weights = np.linspace(1.0, 0.5, num=k)
    penalties = base_penalty * rank_weights
    
    sel_u = u_idx[top_indices]
    sel_v = v_idx[top_indices]
    
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += penalties
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += penalties
    
    return updated_edge_distance
